docs.title: Headset and microphone problems
docs.body: Pick the headset as the input device in the sound settings, then test the microphone in the meeting app.

inputs.title: Headset microphone not working
inputs.description: My headset microphone does not work. I tried picking the headset as the input device in the sound settings and testing the microphone in the meeting app, but it still doesn't work.
